item.description:
Breathe learns new sounds. A preset picker in Settings: Settle is the two-tone sound it launched with; new Resonance paces each breath with soft notes — one to draw in, a lower one to let go — and a gong opens the session and closes it under the final bell. A slider sets the length, three to ten minutes; five stays the default.

Bluetooth headphones, handled properly. If your Mac is playing through its speakers while your headphones sit connected, or they are stuck in call quality because something is using their microphone, the Breathe row now says exactly what to fix. If they change mode mid-session, the sound carries on where it was instead of going silent.
